closure.title: Request business closure
closure.intro: Only the business owner can request closure. A request is a record for the platform team: it deletes nothing and your business, customers, points and rewards keep working exactly as before.
closure.noAccess: Only the business owner can request closure.
closure.loadFailed: We could not load the closure status. Please try again.
closure.blockedBody: Closing a business needs approved rules for settling customer balances, refunds and records that must be kept. Those rules are not approved yet, so closure is blocked. You can still file a request, and you can withdraw it at any time.

blockers.CLOSURE_POLICY_NOT_APPROVED: The closure, settlement and record-retention rules are not approved yet.
blockers.PENDING_REDEMPTIONS: Customers have reward redemptions that are still pending.
blockers.CUSTOMER_POINTS_OUTSTANDING: Customers still hold loyalty points with this business.
blockers.OPEN_REWARD_CLAIMS: Some reward claims are not settled yet.
blockers.ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION: The business has an active subscription.
blockers.ACTIVE_CASHIER_SESSIONS: Cashier sessions are still signed in.
blockers.COMMUNITY_CONTENT_PUBLISHED: The business has published Community posts.
blockers.UNITS_AWAITING_COLLECTION: Sponsored units are still awaiting collection.
blockers.OPEN_GOVERNANCE_CASES: Fraud or dispute cases are still open.

closure.obligationsTitle: What would need to be resolved

closure.fileHint: Confirm your password above first, then type the business name.
closure.filed: Your closure request was recorded. Nothing has been deleted or changed.
